title: Neer Dosa
description: A paper-thin, soft, lace-like Mangalorean rice dosa made from a runny batter of rice and fresh coconut with no fermentation.
steps: Drain the soaked rice and grind it with the grated coconut and 150 ml of the water to a very smooth batter.
Add the remaining water and the salt, mixing until the batter is thin and flows like buttermilk.
Heat a flat non-stick tawa and brush it very lightly with coconut oil.
Stir the batter well and pour from the edge in a spiral, then swirl the tawa quickly to cover the base.
Cover and cook for 1 minute only, until the dosa turns opaque and cooked; do not brown it or flip it.
Fold into a triangle and serve warm with coconut chutney or a spicy curry.
